spans.text: ‘idhekaccassa evarūpaṁ adukkhamasukhaṁ vedanaṁ vedayato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti kusalā dhammā parihāyantī’ti, evāhaṁ ajānanto ‘evarūpaṁ adukkhamasukhaṁ vedanaṁ pajahathā’ti vadeyyaṁ; ‘When someone feels this kind of neutral feeling, unskillful qualities grow and skillful qualities decline.’
‘When someone feels this kind of neutral feeling, unskillful qualities grow and skillful qualities decline.’
